title: Keep collection-existence predicates on the database
goal: Filter stored lists and binary values before materialization using EF11 List.Exists and byte array Any; retain executed server-side alternatives on EF10.

selectionNotes: Osprey survey readings use nullable JSON integer lists and nullable binary signals. EF11 translates Exists to EXISTS over json_each or OPENJSON, and binary Any to length or DATALENGTH. Explicit null guards exclude nulls; empty collections yield no match. The populated row alone matches. EF10 rejects these direct predicates before sending a command; it does not silently evaluate these filters on the client. List.Any remains valid. Use the fixed SQL length query for binary values: EF10 rewrites the apparent Length > 0 alternative to unsupported Any. Keep user values parameterized. No index-use, query-plan or performance claim follows.
